questions.q: When a number is increased by 120\% then it becomes 70 less than another number, but if that number is increased by 80\% then it becomes 130 less than that second number. Find the difference of both the numbers.
questions.s: Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, seedha $120\%$ aur $80\%$ ka farq dekh, aur udhar $130$ aur $70$ ke gap ko pakad. Ek linear equation dimag me ban jani chahiye bina pen uthaye. Language trap me nahi fasna hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach - Highly Recommended): $120\%$ aur $80\%$ ke beech ka gap hai $40\%$. Udhar numbers ka gap hai $130 - 70 = 60$. Seedha equate maar: $40\% \equiv 60$. Toh $100\%$ (pehla number) hua $150$. Ab $150$ ka $120\%$ badhayega ($+180$) toh $330$ aayega. Ye dusre number se $70$ kam hai, matlab dusra number $= 330 + 70 = 400$ hai. Dono ka difference pucha hai: $400 - 150 = 250$. Uda diya secondon me! Method 2 (Algebraic Approach - Tera Corrected $2.2x$ & $1.8x$ method): Maan le pehla number $x$ aur dusra $y$ hai. Condition 1: $x$ ko $120\%$ badhaya toh $100\% + 120\% = 220\%$ hua, yani $2.2x$. Equation: $y - 2.2x = 70$ Condition 2: $x$ ko $80\%$ badhaya toh wo $1.8x$ banega. Equation: $y - 1.8x = 130$ Dono ko subtract karne par: $-0.4x = -60 \Rightarrow x = 150$. Isko first equation me rakh: $y - 2.2(150) = 70 \Rightarrow y - 330 = 70 \Rightarrow y = 400$. Difference $= 400 - 150 = 250$. Method 3 (Concept Builder - $100x$ Assumption): Pehla number maan le $100x$. Usme $120\%$ joda toh ban gaya $220x$. Question kehta hai ye dusre number ($y$) se $70$ kam hai, yani $220x = y - 70$. Jab $80\%$ joda toh ban gaya $180x$, jo $y$ se $130$ kam hai, yani $180x = y - 130$. Dono equations ko ghata de, $40x = 60$ aayega, $x = 1.5$ banega. Toh $100x = 150$. $y$ ki value nikalega toh $400$ aayegi. Farq nikal le $400 - 150 = 250$ aayega. Exam Takeaway: Bhai meri ek baat dhyan se sun, agar exam me Method 2 ($2.2x, 1.8x$) ya Method 3 ($100x, y$) laga ke aisi equations likhega, toh time bohot khichega aur selection door chala jayega. SSC CGL aur CDS me time hi sab kuch hai. Aisi word problems ko hawa me udane ke liye humesha Method 1 (Unitary Scaling) ko hi prefer karna. Percentage gap ko value gap ke barabar rakh aur direct answer nikal!

questions.q: Khushi scores $33.33\%$ in an examination and after review, even though her score is increased by $40\%$, she fails by 10 marks. If her post - review score is increased by $14.28\%$, she will have 10 marks more than the passing score. Find the percentage score needed for passing the examination.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, fraction ka khel hai. $33.33\%$ matlab $\frac{1}{3}$, $40\%$ matlab $\frac{2}{5}$ aur $14.28\%$ matlab $\frac{1}{7}$. Base aisi value maan jo in sabse kat jaye, jaise $300$! Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Total marks $300$ maan le. Khushi ka score aaya $100$ unit. Usme $40\%$ badhaya toh ban gaya $140$ unit. Ye passing marks se $10$ kam hai. Passing = $140u + 10$. Phir is $140u$ ko $14.28\%$ (yani $\frac{1}{7}$) badhaya, toh $140 + 20 = 160$ unit hua. Ye passing se $10$ jyada hai. Passing = $160u - 10$. Equate karega toh $140u + 10 = 160u - 10 \implies 20u = 20 \implies u = 1$. Total marks $300$ hue. Passing marks $140 + 10 = 150$ hue. Ye $300$ ka exactly $50\%$ hai. Bawal trick hai ye! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variables me khelna hai toh Total = $x$. Initial score = $\frac{x}{3}$. After first review = $\frac{x}{3} \times \frac{140}{100} = \frac{14x}{30}$. Fails by 10, toh Passing = $\frac{14x}{30} + 10$. Second review me score = $\frac{14x}{30} \times \frac{8}{7} = \frac{16x}{30}$. Passes by 10, toh Passing = $\frac{16x}{30} - 10$. Dono equations barabar kar de. Vahi $x = 300$ aayega. Mazdoori lambi hai, tu Ninja technique hi lagana exam me. Exam Takeaway: Jab multiple fractions dikhein, toh total hamesha unke denominators ka LCM maana kar!
StageScore (Units)
1. Initial ($33.33\%$)100u
2. Review 1 ($+40\%$)140u (Fail by 10)
3. Review 2 ($+14.28\%$)160u (Pass by 10)

questions.q: If house tax is paid before the due date, one gets a reduction of $12\%$ on the amount of the bill. By paying the tax before the due date, a person got a reduction of $\text{Rs. } 2,100$. The amount (in Rs) of house tax paid was:
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, aakhiri keyword pe teri aankh baaz ki tarah honi chahiye. Question puch raha hai amount 'PAID', na ki 'TOTAL BILL'. Examiner yahi trap set karta hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Reduction $12\%$ ki hui aur amount me $2100$ ki. Yani $12\% = 2100$. $1\% = \frac{2100}{12} = 175$. Total bill $100\% = 17500$ ka tha. Par usne reduction ke baad pay kiya hai na! Toh $17500 - 2100 = 15400$. Option C (17500) mat mark kar dena jaldbazi me! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Ek aur direct tarika dekh. Tujhe 'Paid' amount puchi hai. Agar $12\%$ ki chhoot mili, toh pay kitna kiya? $88\%$. Agar $12\% = 2100$, toh $88\% = \frac{2100}{12} \times 88 = 175 \times 88 = 15400$. Seedha ek step me aagaya answer! Exam Takeaway: Language ko last word tak dhyan se padh. SSC aise hi silly mistakes karwata hai.
CalculationValue
1. Discount ($12\%$)2100
2. Paid Amount ($88\%$)15400

questions.q: In a group of 50 people, 28 have traveled to Europe, 31 have traveled to Asia, and 10 have traveled to both continents. How many people have not traveled to either continent?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM / Deviation (Set Theory) Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, basic Venn diagram ya Set Theory ka sawal hai. Values choti hain, pen ki zaroorat hi nahi, mind me hi add-subtract kar. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Total log jo kahin na kahin gaye hain = Europe + Asia - Both. Yani $28 + 31 - 10 = 49$. Total log group me $50$ the. Toh kitne log kahin nahi gaye? Seedha $50 - 49 = 1$. Secondon ka game hai! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Venn Diagram imagine kar. Beech me 'Both' wale $10$ rakh. 'Only Europe' wale bache $28 - 10 = 18$. 'Only Asia' wale bache $31 - 10 = 21$. Ab sabko jod le: Only E (18) + Only A (21) + Both (10) = 49. Total 50 me se 49 gaye toh bacha sirf 1. Aise concept build hota hai. Exam Takeaway: Jab tak 3 set wala sawal na ho, Venn diagram mat banana. Seedha $n(A \cup B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A \cap B)$ lagaya kar.
CategoryPeople
1. Traveled Anywhere$28 + 31 - 10 = 49$
2. Traveled Nowhere$50 - 49 = 1$

questions.q: In an examination, the maximum possible score is N while the pass mark is $45\%$ of N. A candidate obtains 36 marks, but falls short of the pass mark by $68\%$. Which one of the following is then correct?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, CDS style ka ghumane wala sawal hai! 'Falls short by $68\%$' padhte hi samajh jaa ki usne total passing marks ka bacha hua percentage hi score kiya hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Pass mark apne aap me $100\%$ benchmark hai. Agar koi $68\%$ se piche reh gaya, toh usne laya kitna? Sirf $100\% - 68\% = 32\%$ of passing marks! Ab $32\% = 36$ marks hai. Toh passing marks hue $\frac{36}{32} \times 100 = 112.5$. Question keh raha hai Pass marks N ka $45\%$ hai. Toh $0.45N = 112.5 \implies N = \frac{11250}{45} = 250$. Ab option check kar, 250 kahan fit hota hai? Option D ($243 < N < 252$) me perfectly lie karta hai! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Lamba likhna hai toh likh: Pass = $P$. Score = $P - 0.68P = 0.32P$. Given $0.32P = 36 \implies P = 112.5$. Fir $P = 0.45N \implies 112.5 = 0.45N \implies N = 250$. Concept wahi hai bas variable badle hain. Exam Takeaway: 'Falls short by X\%' ka direct matlab hai usne $(100-X)\%$ score kiya hai benchmark ka. Hamesha remaining percentage pe khela kar!
StepCalculation
1. Passing Marks Base$32\% = 36 \implies 100\% = 112.5$
2. Maximum Marks (N)$45\% = 112.5 \implies 100\% = 250$

questions.q: The ratio of savings of two individuals is 6: 5. If one increases his savings by $15\%$ and the other by $10\%$, find their new savings ratio. (PHASE XIII(HS) - $\frac{28}{07}$/2025 - SHIFT 2)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 4. Cross-Product Method / Ratio Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, ratios ke sath percentage me khelna ho toh base bada kar liya kar. 6 aur 5 ko seedha 60 aur 50, ya 600 aur 500 maan le. Calculation pen-free ho jayegi. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Savings maan le 60 aur 50. Pehle me $15\%$ bada, toh naya $60 \times 1.15 = 69$ hua. Dusre me $10\%$ bada, toh $50 \times 1.10 = 55$ hua. Naya ratio $69 : 55$ ban gaya. Dono prime-like category me phas rahe hain, kisi se nahi katega, isliye yahi final answer hai! Option B seedha thokh! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Ratio me variables lagao: $6x$ aur $5x$. New ratio banega $(6x \times \frac{115}{100}) : (5x \times \frac{110}{100})$. $100$ se $100$ aur $x$ se $x$ cut jayega. Bacha $(6 \times 115) : (5 \times 110) = 690 : 550$. Zero cut karke $69 : 55$ aagaya. Par mazdoori kyu karni jab direct number soch sakte ho? Exam Takeaway: Ratio values me jab percentage change aaye, zero chipka kar decimals ko avoid kiya kar.
Initial ValueFinal Value
60$60 + (15\%) = 69$
50$50 + (10\%) = 55$

questions.q: A, B and C spend $75\%$, $80\%$ and $90\%$ of their incomes, respectively. If their savings are in the ratio 4: 6: 5 and the difference between the incomes of A and C is 25,500, then the income of B is?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, expenditure percentage diya hai par ratio savings ka diya hai. Ulta sochna padega. Incomes nikalne ke liye savings ko uske percentage se bhag (divide) de. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Pehle saving percentage nikal: A=$25\%$, B=$20\%$, C=$10\%$. Ab direct Income ratio likh = $\frac{\text{Saving Ratio}}{\text{Saving } \%}$. Yani $\frac{4}{25} : \frac{6}{20} : \frac{5}{10}$. Percentage hata de kyunki ratio me common cut jayega. Bacha $\frac{4}{25} : \frac{6}{20} : \frac{5}{10} \implies \frac{16}{100} : \frac{30}{100} : \frac{50}{100}$. Base 100 cut gaya, naya ratio $16:30:50$ yaani $8:15:25$ aagaya. A aur C ka difference $25 - 8 = 17$ unit hai. Sawal kehta hai ye $25500$ hai. $1$ unit = $1500$. B ki income puchi hai ($15$ unit), toh $15 \times 1500 = 22500$ answer hoga! Bawal cheez hai ye ratio base shifting. Method 2 (Concept Builder): A ki income ka $25\% = 4x \implies A = 16x$. B ki income ka $20\% = 6x \implies B = 30x$. C ki income ka $10\% = 5x \implies C = 50x$. Income ratio $16x : 30x : 50x = 8 : 15 : 25$. Diff $25 - 8 = 17$ unit $= 25500$. $1$ unit $= 1500$. $B = 15 \times 1500 = 22500$. Exam Takeaway: Expenditure diya ho aur saving ratio pooche to turant $100 - x$ karke equate kar liya kar.
PersonIncome Ratio
A$4 / 25\% = 16$
B$6 / 20\% = 30$
C$5 / 10\% = 50$

questions.q: Rajan spent $10\%$ of his salary on rent. He spent $20\%$ of the remaining part of the salary on transport. After which he spent $40\%$ of the balance of the salary on food. Further, he spent $80\%$ of the balance on various bills. He deposits $\text{Rs. } 5000$ in the bank and kept the remaining $\text{Rs. } 1480$ for his own petty expenditure. Find his monthly salary (in Rs.).
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction) Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, bar-bar 'remaining part' likha hai, seedha Successive Change ka chain lagana hai. End me jo bhi paisa bacha (bank me daala + khud rakha) wo sab final remainder hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Final amount bacha $5000 + 1480 = 6480$. Salary ko $S$ maan aur seedha bachi hui fractions likh: $10\%$ kharch $\to \frac{9}{10}$ bacha, $20\% \to \frac{4}{5}$, $40\% \to \frac{3}{5}$, $80\% \to \frac{1}{5}$. Equation bani: $S \times \frac{9}{10} \times \frac{4}{5} \times \frac{3}{5} \times \frac{1}{5} = 6480$. Upar walon ko multiply karega toh $9 \times 4 \times 3 = 108$ aayega. $108$ se $6480$ kata $60$ baar me. Neeche ka base $10 \times 5 \times 5 \times 5 = 1250$ udhar jake multiply hua. $S = 60 \times 1250 = 75000$. Secondon me uda diya bhai! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Ya fir aise decimals me likh: $S \times 0.9 \times 0.8 \times 0.6 \times 0.2 = 6480$. $9 \times 8 \times 6 \times 2 = 864$ aayega. Yani $S \times 0.0864 = 6480$. $S = \frac{6480}{0.0864} = 75000$. Digital Sum bhi check kar sakta hai par itna sidha cut raha hai ki zaroorat nahi. Exam Takeaway: 'Of the remaining' padhte hi fractions ki chain bana kar directly equate kar diya kar.
Fraction ChainFinal Equate
$\frac{9}{10} \times \frac{4}{5} \times \frac{3}{5} \times \frac{1}{5}$$\frac{108}{1250}$
$S \times \frac{108}{1250} = 6480$$S = 75000$

questions.q: The price of petrol is increased by $30\%$ then a man can purchase 9 lt. less petrol for $\text{Rs. } 780$. Find Original Purchase, Present Purchase, Original Rate, Present Rate
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 1. CPR (Constant Product Ratio) Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, budget $780$ constant hai, seedha fractional jump lagana hai. Jab kharcha same ho toh price aur consumption ulte chalte hain. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Price me vridhi hui $30\%$ yani $+\frac{3}{10}$. Toh consumption me kami aayegi $-\frac{3}{13}$ ki. Question kehta hai 9 liter kam kharida. Yani $3$ unit = 9 liter, toh $1$ unit = 3 liter. Original consumption base (13 unit) thi: $13 \times 3 = 39$ Ltr. Present consumption 3 unit kam hui, yani $10 \times 3 = 30$ Ltr. Ab rate nikal le: Original Rate = $780 / 39 = 20$ Rs/Ltr. Present Rate = $780 / 30 = 26$ Rs/Ltr. Combo ban gaya: 39, 30, 20, 26. Option D tick maar! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Ek aur shortcut dekh. Agar budget wahi rakhna hai par petrol 30% mehenga ho gaya, toh $780$ ka $30\%$ yani $234$ rupay extra chahiye the. Usne nahi diye, isliye petrol pump wale ne $9$ liter petrol kam diya. Yani nayi keemat hai $234 / 9 = 26$ Rs/L. Agar naya rate $26$ hai (jo ki original ka $130\%$ hai), toh original = $26 / 1.3 = 20$ Rs/L. Dono rate nikal gaye, quantity nikalna baccho ka khel hai. Exam Takeaway: CPR fraction fraction kheliyo aisi jagah pe. $+\frac{x}{y} \implies -\frac{x}{x+y}$ hamesha kaam aayega.
StepCalculation
1. Naya Rate$30\%$ of 780 = $234 / 9 = 26 \text{ Rs/L}$
2. Purana Rate$26 / 1.3 = 20 \text{ Rs/L}$
3. Original Qty$780 / 20 = 39 \text{ L}$

questions.q: If the volume of a cube increases by $119.7\%$, what is the percentage change in its total surface area?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction) Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, Volume 3D ($x^3$) me chalta hai aur Area 2D ($x^2$) me. Tujhe cube root lekar side pe aana hai fir square karke area nikalna hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Volume $100$ se badh kar $219.7$ ho gaya. Zero shift kar de toh ratio banega $1000 : 2197$. Ye kiske cube hain? $10^3$ aur $13^3$. Yani cube ki side 10 se 13 ho gayi. Hamein 2D (Surface Area) chahiye, toh side ka square kar de: $10^2 : 13^2 = 100 : 169$. $100$ se $169$ ho jana matlab direct $69\%$ ki vridhi. Ye cubes 15 tak raate hone chahiye bhai! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Side $= a$. Naya volume $= 2.197 a^3$. Nayi side $= \sqrt[3]{2.197} a = 1.3 a$. Purana Surface Area $= 6a^2$. Naya Surface Area $= 6(1.3a)^2 = 6 \times 1.69 a^2$. Multiplier $1.69$ aagaya, jiska matlab $+69\%$ hota hai. Exam Takeaway: $10\%$, $20\%$, $30\%$ ke 3 saal ke CI / Volume multipliers dimag me chap le. Jaise hi 219.7 dikha, $30\%$ (1.3) yaad aana chahiye.
DimensionMultiplier
1. Volume (3D)2.197 ($13^3 / 10^3$)
2. Side (1D)1.3 ($13 / 10$)
3. Area (2D)1.69 ($+69\%$)

questions.q: In an examination, a student who gets $20\%$ of the maximum marks fails by 5 marks. Another student who scores $30\%$ of the maximum marks gets 20 marks more than the pass marks. The necessary percentage required for passing is ?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, ek fail hua 5 marks se ($-5$) aur dusra pass se $20$ aage chala gaya ($+20$). Marks ka total gap aur percentage ka total gap aamne samne rakh. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Percentages ka gap: $30\% - 20\% = 10\%$. Marks ka gap: $20 - (-5) = 25$ marks. Agar $10\% = 25$ marks hai, toh har percentage point me kitne marks hue? Ya fir aise soch, $5$ marks ki aukaat percentage me kitni hai? Agar 25 marks ka $10\%$ banta hai, toh 5 marks banenge $(10/25) \times 5 = 2\%$. Pehla baccha 5 marks se fail hua tha, yani usko pass hone ke liye $2\%$ aur chahiye the. Pass percentage banega $20\% + 2\% = 22\%$. Smart calculation karega toh Total nikalne ka waste of time bachega! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Pehle total marks ($x$) nikal le. $10\% \text{ of } x = 25 \implies x = 250$. Ab pass marks nikal: $20\% \text{ of } 250 + 5 = 50 + 5 = 55$. Passing percentage: $(55 / 250) \times 100 = 22\%$. Badi mazdoori karni padti hai isme. Exam Takeaway: Absolute marks ko directly percentage me convert karke fail wale me jod diya kar.
EquatingConversion
1. $10\%$ Gap25 Marks
2. Pass Requirement$20\% + (5 \text{ marks} \to 2\%) = 22\%

questions.q:
Quantity I: if the length of a rectangle is increased by $40\%$ while the breadth of the rectangle is decreased by $20\%$ then find percentage change in area of the rectangle?
Quantity II: if the side of a triangle is increased by $60\%$ while the height of a triangle is decreased by $40\%$ then find the percentage change in area of the triangle?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction) Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, Area ka formula humesha do variables ka product hota hai (jaise $L \times B$ ya $1/2 \times B \times H$). Constant ($1/2$) se percentage change ko fark nahi padta. Dono jagah AB rule ($a+b+ab/100$) lagana hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Q I ke liye: $+40$ aur $-20$. Formula: $40 - 20 - \frac{40 \times 20}{100} = 20 - 8 = +12\%$. Q II ke liye: $+60$ aur $-40$. Formula: $60 - 40 - \frac{60 \times 40}{100} = 20 - 24 = -4\%$. Saaf dikh raha hai ki $+12\%$ bada hai $-4\%$ se, yani Quantity I > Quantity II. Bina tension direct compare kar de! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Fractions se kar le. Q I: $L$ badha $\frac{2}{5}$ se ($\to 7/5$), $B$ ghata $\frac{1}{5}$ se ($\to 4/5$). Area $= \frac{7}{5} \times \frac{4}{5} = \frac{28}{25}$. Change = $+3/25 = +12\%$. Q II: Base badha $\frac{3}{5}$ se ($\to 8/5$), Height ghati $\frac{2}{5}$ se ($\to 3/5$). Area $= \frac{8}{5} \times \frac{3}{5} = \frac{24}{25}$. Change = $-1/25 = -4\%$. Dono tarike fit hain. Exam Takeaway: Product based formulas me sidha successive wala funda chipkao. Constant numbers percentage change me aukaat nahi rakhte!
QuantityNet Change
1. Rectangle$+12\%$
2. Triangle$-4\%$

questions.q: Two candidates P and Q are contesting elections in a city. $80\%$ of the registered voters voted in the election and P won the election by 160 votes. If Q had got $25\%$ more votes then the result of the election would have been a tie, then how many people did not vote?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 4. Cross-Product Method / Ratio Balancing Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, thoda ghuma hua sawal hai. Tie ka matlab hota hai dono ke votes barabar ho jana. Par 'if Q got 25% more' ka assumption wahan ke fixed valid votes me P ka nuksan nahi dikha raha, bas usne bahar se votes cover kiye aise treat kar. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): P aur Q ka margin 160 tha. Yaani $P - Q = 160$. Tie karne ke liye Q ko P ke barabar aana hai, yani usey aur 160 votes chahiye the. Question kehta hai ki agar usko $25\%$ jyada milte toh tie hota. Iska matlab uske existing votes ka $25\%$ hi $160$ votes ke barabar hai! Yani $25\%$ of Q = 160 $\implies$ Q ke asal vote = $160 \times 4 = 640$. Toh P ke vote $= 640 + 160 = 800$. Total valid vote kitne pade? $800 + 640 = 1440$. Oye wait, result of election as tie meaning agar unhi casted votes me change hota toh? 'If Q had got 25% more votes... tie' means from the same pool. P se Q ki taraf shift hue! Agar shift hue toh margin cover hoga. Q ko mile $25\%$ zyada yani $0.25Q$. P ko itna hi loss hua hoga, tab dono barabar. Yani original gap $P - Q = 2 \times 0.25Q = 0.5Q$. Margin $160$ diya hai. $0.5Q = 160 \implies Q = 320$. P $= 480$. Total cast = $480 + 320 = 800$. Ye valid votes the (registered ke $80\%$). Toh register $= 1000$. Didn't vote ($20\%$) $= 200$. Concept hila dene wala sawal tha ye! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Equations bana le. P + Q = Total Voted. P - Q = 160. Nayi condition: $Q + 0.25Q = P - 0.25Q \implies P = 1.5Q$. Is value ko daal de $P - Q = 160$ me. $1.5Q - Q = 160 \implies 0.5Q = 160 \implies Q = 320$. Uske baad upar wali calculations lag jaayengi. Exam Takeaway: Election tie wale cases me jiska badh raha hai, utna hi dusre ka ghata kar gap cover karna hota hai!
VariableValue
1. Votes of Q320
2. Total Cast ($80\%$)800
3. Didn't Vote ($20\%$)200

questions.q: In a society 500 people are living $45\%$ play cricket, $29\%$ play hockey and $48\%$ play badminton, $18\%$ didn't any play game while $5\%$ people play all three games. If $6\%$ people play cricket and hockey both and $27\%$ play cricket and badminton both find the number of people who play only badminton?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM / Deviation (Set Theory) Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, ye 3 wala diagrammatic set theory hai. Agar $18\%$ kuch nahi khelte, toh remaining $82\%$ kuch na kuch khel rahe hain. Seedha formula equate kar. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Formula pata hai na? $Total(A \cup B \cup C) = A + B + C - (A \cap B) - (B \cap C) - (A \cap C) + All(3)$. Yahan values daal: $82 = 45 + 29 + 48 - 6 - 27 - x + 5$. Solve kar: $82 = 127 - 33 - x + 5 \implies x = 127 - 28 - 82 = 17$? Check again: $82 = 94 - x \implies x = 12$. Yani Hockey & Badminton khelne wale $12\%$ hue. Ab chahiye 'Only Badminton'. Only Badminton $= B - (C \cap B) - (H \cap B) + All(3)$. Ye $+ All$ zaroori hai kyunki tune 5% ko do baar ghata diya intersect karne me. Toh $48 - 27 - 12 + 5 = 14\%$. Ab $500$ ka $14\%$ nikal de: $14 \times 5 = 70$. Shandaar calculation. Method 2 (Concept Builder): Venn Diagram bana, beech me 5 rakh. C & H = 6 tha, toh keval (C&H) = $6-5 = 1$. C & B = 27 tha, toh keval (C&B) = $27-5 = 22$. Ab bacha hua nikalega toh (H&B) ka only = 7 aayega. Badminton total 48 hai, toh Only B = $48 - (22 + 5 + 7) = 14\%$. Final count: $500 \times 0.14 = 70$. Dono se jawab mast aayega. Exam Takeaway: Only(C) nikalne ke liye hamesha formula $Total - Intersect1 - Intersect2 + All(3)$ laga diya kar, diagram se fast hai.
SegmentPercentage
1. Badminton Total$48\%$
2. Only Badminton$48 - 27 - 12 + 5 = 14\%$

questions.q: If the population of a town is 1,21,000 and it increases at an annual rate of $10\%$, what will be the difference between the population of the town after three years and the population of the town two years ago?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction) Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai aise karna hai... $10\%$ rate matlab seedha $1.1$ ka multiplier yani 11 ki powers lagegi. Base $1,21,000$ bhi $11^2$ ka roop hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Present = $121,000$. 2 saal pehle? Seedha $1.1^2$ (yani 1.21) se divide maar. $\frac{121000}{1.21} = 1,00,000$. 3 saal baad? Seedha $1.1^3$ (yani 1.331) se multiply maar. $121000 \times 1.331$. Decimal hata ke digits khel, $121 \times 1331 = 1,61,051$ aayega. Hame gap chahiye: $1,61,051 - 1,00,000 = 61,051$. Calculation fast honi mangti hai! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Let 2 saal pehle $P$ thi. $P \times \frac{11}{10} \times \frac{11}{10} = 121000$. $P = 100000$. Ab after 3 years = $121000 \times \frac{11}{10} \times \frac{11}{10} \times \frac{11}{10} = 121 \times 1331 = 161051$. Difference $61051$. Basic formula hi best hai aisi standard percentages ke liye. Exam Takeaway: Compound Growth ke questions me 11 ki kam se kam 4 powers muh-jubani yaad rakh: 11, 121, 1331, 14641.
TimelinePopulation
1. 2 Years Ago1,00,000
2. 3 Years After1,61,051

questions.q: Rishabh spends three fourth of his income. His income increases by $2x\%$ and his expenditure also increases by $x\%$. If the percentage of increase in his savings is $50\%$, then find value of $3.75x\%$ of 1440.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Deviation Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, ye JSM ka sabse bawal application hai. Income ke components Expenditure aur Savings hote hain, toh unko as a weighted ratio treat karke sidhi deviation ki equation lagao. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): $\frac{3}{4}$ spend karne ka matlab Income 4, Exp 3, aur Saving 1. Equation likh: $\text{Income change} = \text{Exp change} + \text{Saving change}$. Base variables lagao: $4 \times (2x) = 3 \times (x) + 1 \times (50)$. Solve kar: $8x = 3x + 50 \implies 5x = 50 \implies x = 10$. Hame calculate karna hai $3.75x\%$ of 1440. Jab x 10 hai, toh ye $37.5\%$ ban jayega. $37.5\%$ ko hum pyaar se $\frac{3}{8}$ bulate hain. $\frac{3}{8} \times 1440 = 3 \times 180 = 540$. Examiner confuse karna chahta hai, tu uda de! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Income = 400. Exp = 300. Saving = 100. New Saving = 150 (50% badhi). New Exp = $300 + 3x$. New Income = $400 + 8x$. Relation: New Income = New Exp + New Saving. $400 + 8x = 300 + 3x + 150$. $5x = 50 \implies x = 10$. Wahi result aaya, bas thoda zyada likhna pada. Exam Takeaway: Ratio ko sidha percentages ke base weights par equation bana diya kar, bada fast x ki value aayegi.
CalculationOutput
1. Found 'x'10
2. Final Percent$37.5\% = \frac{3}{8}$

questions.q: In the previous government, party Q was in the opposition. Now increasing the seats by 33.33%, Q is the ruling party and thus party Q enjoys twice the majority than that of party P in the previous government. If there were only two parties P and Q and the fix no. of seats be 500 in the parliament of Hum-Tum, then the no. of seats of the Q in the new government is:
questions.s: Core Conceptual Tool Triggered: 3. JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Deviation: $A + B = K$ and $A' + B' = K$. (Whenever total sum is constant, the actual change in a component equals half the difference of their new and old majorities). The "Pen-Free" Observation First: Dekh bhai, agar Q ki seats 33.33\% (yani $1/3$) badh gayi hain, toh nayi seats purani seats ka $1 + \frac{1}{3} = \frac{4}{3}$ hongi. Iska seedha matlab hai nayi seats 4 ka multiple hongi! Options mein 225 aur 275 sidha eliminate ho gaye. 300 pe cross-verify kar, 10 seconds mein answer match karega. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Bhai jo concept tune image mein bheja hai, ye $A+B=K$ wala Change = $\frac{\text{Final Majority} - \text{Initial Majority}}{2}$ logic ekdam lethal hai aur bheed se 10x aage rakhega! Let purani sarkar mein P ki majority = $1$ unit. Toh Q (opposition) ki majority kya hui? $-1$ unit. Nayi sarkar mein Q ki majority = $2$ units (P ki purani majority ka double). Ab nikal Q ki seats mein kitna exact increment hua is rule se: Increment in Q = $\frac{\text{New Majority} - \text{Old Majority}}{2} = \frac{2 - (-1)}{2} = 1.5$ units. Lekin question ke according, Q ki seats 33.33\% yani purani Q ka $\frac{1}{3}$ badhi hain. So, Q ka $\frac{1}{3}$ = $1.5$ units. $\Rightarrow$ Purani Q = $1.5 \times 3 = 4.5$ units. Nayi Q = Purani Q + Increment = $4.5 + 1.5 = 6$ units. Nayi P = Nayi Q - Majority = $6 - 2 = 4$ units. Total seats = Nayi Q + Nayi P = $6 + 4 = 10$ units. Ab seedha equate kar de: $\Rightarrow 10 \text{ units} = 500 \text{ total seats}$ $\Rightarrow 1 \text{ unit} = 50 \text{ seats}$. Toh Nayi Q ($6 \text{ units}$) = $6 \times 50 = 300$ seats. Boom! Khatam. Method 2 (Concept Builder - Basic Tutors $x$ Method): Total seats = 500. Let purani Q = $3x$, toh Nayi Q = $4x$ (kyuki 33.33\% increase hai). Purani P = $500 - 3x$. Nayi P = $500 - 4x$. Purani Majority (P minus Q) = $(500 - 3x) - 3x = 500 - 6x$. Nayi Majority (Q minus P) = $4x - (500 - 4x) = 8x - 500$. Given condition: Nayi Majority = $2 \times$ Purani Majority $\Rightarrow 8x - 500 = 2(500 - 6x)$ $\Rightarrow 8x - 500 = 1000 - 12x$ $\Rightarrow 20x = 1500$ $\Rightarrow x = 75$. Therefore, Nayi Q = $4x = 4 \times 75 = 300$. Future Exam Takeaway: Tera image wala doubt ekdam solid gold hai! Jab bhi $A+B=K$ ho, directly $\frac{\text{Diff}_2 - \text{Diff}_1}{2}$ lagao to find the net change. Ye elections aur voting wale saare tough questions ko without 'x' uda dega!

questions.q: In a city, 12% of households earn less than Rs. 30,000 per year, 6% households earn more than Rs. 2,00,000 per year, 22% households earn more than Rs. 1,00,000 per year and 990 households earn between Rs. 30,000 and Rs. 1,00,000 per year. How many households earn between Rs. 1,00,000 and Rs. 2,00,000 per year?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, income groups ke brackets banaye gaye hain. Sab percentages ko timeline par set kar de ekdam clear dikhega. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Total population 100% hai. <30k wale hue $12\%$. >100k wale hue $22\%$. Inke beech (yani 30k se 100k ke beech) wale kitne bache? $100\% - (12\% + 22\%) = 66\%$. Ye 66% $990$ households ke barabar de rakha hai. Yani $1\% = \frac{990}{66} = 15$. Ab hamein kya nikalna hai? 100k se 200k ke beech wale. >100k total $22\%$ hain, jisme se >200k wale $6\%$ pehle hi hain. Toh bracket me aaye: $22\% - 6\% = 16\%$. Seedha answer: $16 \times 15 = 240$ households. Ek line ka question tha, language fasa rahi thi! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Range set kar le: A(<30k), B(30-100k), C(100-200k), D(>200k). Given: A = 12%. C + D = 22%. D = 6%. Isliye C = 16%. Total = A + B + C + D = 100%. B = 100% - 12% - 22% = 66%. B = 990. Baki equate karna upar bata hi diya hai. Exam Takeaway: Venn diagram banane ke bajaye hamesha line ya timeline brackets use kar range questions ke liye!
Income BracketPopulation
1. 30k - 100k$66\% \to 990$
2. 100k - 200k$16\% \to 240$
